Speaker: Nazir
Text: Listener. Good. You can settle this before I settle it myself.
Notes: Automatische Szene; Veyra sitzt am Tisch, Nazir steht mit gezogener Klinge ueber ihr

Speaker: Nazir
Text: This one walked through the Black Door like she owned the place. Say the word and I open her up.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: He's been saying that for an hour. I'm beginning to think he doesn't mean it.

Speaker: Babette
Text: Oh, he means it. He just hasn't decided where to start.

Speaker: Cicero
Text: Cicero knows that face! Cicero knows it! But from where, from where...
Notes: Platzhalter-Condition, echte Pruefung ueber Alias NHV_Sys_Sanctuary::Cicero (M1.4); Cicero kauert hinter einer Kiste und kichert

Speaker: Player
Text: Who are you?

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Veyra Othren. Once of Bravil, once of Cheydinhal, once of a dozen sanctuaries that don't exist anymore. The family used to call me the Gleaner.

Speaker: Player
Text: The Gleaner?

Speaker: Veyra
Text: After the harvest, someone walks the fields and gathers what the reapers left behind. That was my work. I found the ones worth keeping.

Speaker: Player
Text: How did you get past the Black Door?

Speaker: Veyra
Text: The door asked me what life's greatest illusion is. I've known the answer since before your Redguard's grandmother was born.

Speaker: Nazir
Text: Careful, elf.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: I'm always careful. It's why I'm still breathing.

Speaker: Player
Text: Why are you here?

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Every soul that ever pledged itself to the Dread Father felt it when the Night Mother spoke again. After all those silent years.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: So I came north. I found Falkreath in ashes. I was too late for them. I don't intend to be too late for you.

Speaker: Player
Text: Nazir, lower your blade. Let her talk.

Speaker: Nazir
Text: ...Fine. But it stays out of its sheath.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: A sensible compromise.

Speaker: Player
Text: Do it, Nazir.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Before he does, Listener, ask the Night Mother. If she wants me dead, I'll hold very still.

Speaker: Nazir
Text: ...The elf has a point. I hate that.

Speaker: Player
Text: I want you out of this Sanctuary.
Notes: Option 6 von 6; fuehrt zu Stage 15, kein weiterer Skripttext im Konzept fuer den Rueckweg

Speaker: Veyra
Text: As you wish. I'll be at the Windpeak Inn. I've waited two hundred years. A few more days won't trouble me.

Speaker: Nazir
Text: An old assassin turns up the moment we're weakest, with a sad story and the right password. That's exactly what a spy would do.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: It's exactly what a spy would do. So don't take my word for it. Take hers.
Notes: Blick zum Sarg der Night Mother → Stage 20

Speaker: Player
Text: Mother, a stranger has come. She calls herself the Gleaner.
Notes: Neuer Dialogzweig auf dem Night-Mother-Actor, nur bei Stage 20

Speaker: NightMother
Text: My Listener. You come with a question on your lips.

Speaker: NightMother
Text: The Gleaner has walked in my shadow longer than you have drawn breath.
Notes: Konzept-Satz (31 Woerter) auf zwei Responses aufgeteilt, siehe docs/DIALOGUE.md

Speaker: NightMother
Text: She gathered for me when the family was many. Let her gather now, when the family is few.

Speaker: Player
Text: Can she be trusted?

Speaker: NightMother
Text: Trust is for the living to squabble over.
Notes: Konzept-Satz (26 Woerter) auf zwei Responses aufgeteilt

Speaker: NightMother
Text: I know only this: her heart beats for Sithis. What she does with it is yours to watch.

Speaker: Player
Text: Why did she leave the family?
Notes: Option 2 von 3; markiert NightMotherOption2 fuer die spaetere Proposal-Szene (Stage 30)

Speaker: NightMother
Text: Ask her, my Listener. Her answer will tell you more than mine.

Speaker: Player
Text: Why have you never spoken to her?

Speaker: NightMother
Text: I speak to one. It has always been one. That is the burden of the Listener, and the wound of all the rest.

Speaker: Cicero
Text: Cicero remembers now! Cheydinhal! The pointy-eared lady who LEFT! Who left Cicero alone with Mother and the dust and the rats!
Notes: Platzhalter-Condition, echte Pruefung ueber Alias NHV_Sys_Sanctuary::Cicero (M1.4); faengt den Spieler auf dem Rueckweg ab. OFFENE FRAGE (lore-editor): Stage-Tabelle setzt Stage 30 bereits bei "Night-Mother-Dialog beendet", eine reine GetStage==20-Bedingung koennte die Szene dann verpassen. Mit Entwickler klaeren, ob eine Alias-/Flag-Bedingung statt Stage-Wert noetig ist

Speaker: Cicero
Text: Cicero talked to the rats for years, you know. They were terrible listeners. Terrible!

Speaker: Player
Text: She's here now. That counts for something.

Speaker: Cicero
Text: Does it? Does it count? Cicero will count. Cicero is very good at counting grudges.

Speaker: Player
Text: You have every right to be angry.

Speaker: Cicero
Text: Yes! Rights! Cicero has so many rights! Thank you, Listener!

Speaker: Player
Text: Not now, Cicero.

Speaker: Cicero
Text: Not now. Never now. Always later with Cicero...
Notes: Aufloesung erst in der Szene "The Keeper and the Gleaner" (Abschnitt 11, M5.3)

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Well? Am I to be gutted or put to work?

Speaker: Player
Text: The Night Mother vouches for you. Welcome to the family.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Family. No one has said that word to me in a very long time. Thank you, Listener.

Speaker: Player
Text: The Night Mother vouches for you. I don't. Not yet.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Good. Keep that doubt sharp. It's the only thing that could have saved Falkreath.

Speaker: Player
Text: Why did you leave Cheydinhal?
Notes: Option 3 von 3, nur wenn Stage-020-Option 2 gewaehlt wurde; Tracking-Mechanismus (Stage-Zwischenschritt oder Alias-Variable) im CK klaeren

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Because the Night Mother went quiet, and I was young enough to think silence meant absence. Cicero stayed. The fool stayed. And he was right.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Don't tell him I said that. He'd never let me forget it.
Notes: Platzhalter-Condition, s. o.; OFFENE FRAGE (lore-editor): Zeile ergibt inhaltlich nur nach der NightMotherOption2-Rueckblende (030_06/07) Sinn. Falls im CK als eigene INFO statt Folge-Response umgesetzt, Bedingung um NightMotherOption2 == 1 ergaenzen

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Then hear my proposal.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: The family is currently two killers, a jester and a horse.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: The family is currently two killers and a horse.

Speaker: Babette
Text: I'll have you know I count as at least three killers on my own.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: The Brotherhood has never posted notices. We watch.
Notes: Konzept-Satz (32 Woerter) auf drei Responses aufgeteilt

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Across Skyrim there are people who have already crossed the line. Killers who don't yet know they're family.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: I keep a ledger of them.

Speaker: Nazir
Text: And after Astrid, you want us to open the door to strangers?

Speaker: Veyra
Text: No. I want us to open it to the right strangers. Every one of them watched, tested and judged. By the Listener. Not by me.

Speaker: Player
Text: Agreed. We rebuild.

Speaker: Player
Text: What's in it for you?

Speaker: Veyra
Text: A family. A home that doesn't burn. And one day, perhaps, a name on a wall that someone bothers to remember.

Speaker: Player
Text: How do I know one of them won't be the next Astrid?

Speaker: Veyra
Text: You don't. That's why we test them. And that's why you decide, not me.

Speaker: Nazir
Text: ...Contracts are scarce anyway. Fine. She answers to the Listener, and I keep my scimitar sharp.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: I would expect nothing less.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: One more thing. This place is older than you think.
Notes: Konzept-Satz (36 Woerter) auf drei Responses aufgeteilt

Speaker: Veyra
Text: There's a passage behind that rubble, sealed before any of us were born.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: If we mean to build a family, we'll need somewhere to put it.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Nordic. Older than the sanctuary above. Someone sealed this for a reason.
Notes: OFFENE FRAGE (lore-editor): Stage-Tabelle setzt "Geroell aktiviert, Zellwechsel" als Ausloeser fuer Stage 50, diese Zeile faellt aber zeitlich danach. Mit Entwickler klaeren, ob Stage hier 50 statt 40 sein sollte, bevor die Szene im CK gebaut wird. Spieler aktiviert Geroell, Zellwechsel in die verfallene Deep Sanctuary, 3 Draugr bewachen die Kammern

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Well. Now we know the reason.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: A long table. A fire pit. Imagine it full.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Festus. Gabriella. Arnbjorn. Veezara. I'll carve their names myself.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: And Astrid? She led them. She also sold them. Your call, Listener.

Speaker: Player
Text: Carve her name with the others.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Mercy for the dead. The dead rarely deserve it, but they never complain.

Speaker: Player
Text: Leave her off.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Forgotten, then. The Void will remember her. We needn't.

Speaker: Player
Text: Carve it beneath the others. Smaller.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Remembered, but not honored. I like the way you think.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Before Falkreath burned, the Night Mother heard a prayer from Hjaalmarch. A Black Sacrament. No one answered it. There was no one left to answer.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Let's find out what became of the one who performed it.

Speaker: Player
Text: What about the initiates who are already here?
Notes: Optional, nur wenn Vanilla-Initiates in der Sanctuary vorhanden sind; vor Stage 100 verfuegbar

Speaker: Veyra
Text: They found the door by luck, not judgment. Luck is a fine thing. Judgment lasts longer. I'll keep an eye on them.
Notes: Konzept schreibt "judgement" (britisch); auf amerikanische Schreibweise korrigiert (E12, docs/DIALOGUE.md)
